purpose: Record actual tracking and per-keyframe confidence-weighted canonical pointmap updates for E1 KF31-35
settings: same inputs, checkpoint, uncalibrated, 512 long side, single thread, 64 KF buffer, 1 s forced periodic keyframes, low VRAM
probe: monkeypatch tracker functions in parent process; save ROI arrays before and after original update, including incoming transformed pointmap, confidences, match validity and relative Sim3; no modification of model inputs or outputs
verification: exact final PLY and trajectory SHA-256 comparison to E1; evaluate N and weighted update arithmetic and sequential continuity
metrics: PCA absolute orthogonal p90 normalized by initial ROI projected bounding-box diagonal; update and cumulative normal displacement, confidence weights and correspondence validity
limitations: image polygons are exploratory and may not be perfectly planar; no ground truth; tracking and fusion are coupled; final export parity alone is not intermediate full parity
